convergence.description: Gate config-done on the cisco_iol MPLS L3VPN converging. Show-based (no live ping): asserts the programmed state — OSPF FULL, LDP Oper, and a label-switched FIB entry (show ip cef vrf) toward each remote customer site. Runs via the netlab-runner's `netlab exec` (per-NOS transport). Customer loopbacks (10.2.0.1-.4) are netlab-derived and hardcoded — see the test-suite-hardcoded-ips follow-up.

ospf_full.description: Every node has a FULL OSPF adjacency (the area-0 core is up).

ldp_operational.description: Every node has an LDP session in State: Oper (MPLS transport LSPs up).

fib_reach_pe1_to_pe2.command: show ip cef vrf vpn_a 10.2.0.2 detail
fib_reach_pe1_to_pe2.description: pe1's VRF FIB label-switches toward pe2's customer site (VPNv4 imported + LSP programmed).

fib_reach_pe1_to_pe3.command: show ip cef vrf vpn_a 10.2.0.3 detail
fib_reach_pe1_to_pe3.description: pe1's VRF FIB label-switches toward pe3's customer site.

fib_reach_pe1_to_pe4.command: show ip cef vrf vpn_a 10.2.0.4 detail
fib_reach_pe1_to_pe4.description: pe1's VRF FIB label-switches toward pe4's customer site.

fib_reach_pe4_to_pe1.command: show ip cef vrf vpn_a 10.2.0.1 detail
fib_reach_pe4_to_pe1.description: pe4's VRF FIB label-switches toward pe1's customer site (reverse path).
